objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-cisco-secure-endpoint-uninstall-immunet-service-via-sfc
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of the sfc.exe utility with the "-u" parameter, which is part of the Cisco Secure Endpoint installation. The "-u" flag allows the uninstallation of Cisco Secure Endpoint components. This detection leverages endpoint telemetry to monitor command-line executions that include the "-u" parameter.
